text:
Predicates:
GivenOut(x, y) ::: x is given out on TV at time y.
On(x, y) ::: x is on TV show y.
Bachelor(x) ::: x is on The Bachelor.
Portrays(x, y) ::: x portrays the lives of people in TV show y.
RealityTV(x) ::: x is a reality TV show.
Premises:
∃x (GivenOut(rose, monday8pm)) ::: On some Mondays at 8 pm, roses are given out on TV.
∀x (GivenOut(x, y) → On(x, TheBachelor)) ::: Every rose given out on TV is on the Bachelor.
∀x (On(x, TheBachelor) → Portrays(x, realPeople)) ::: Everything on the Bachelor portrays the lives of real people.
∀x (Portrays(x, realPeople) → RealityTV(x)) ::: All shows portraying the lives of real people are reality TV shows.
¬RealityTV(breakingBad) ::: Breaking Bad is not a reality TV show.
Conclusion:
GivenOut(rose, monday8pm) ∧ On(breakingBad, monday8pm) ::: Breaking Bad is a TV show in which roses are given out on Monday at 8 pm.
